Product Overview Carbatit 200mg is a medication used to treat certain types of seizures and nerve pain, such as trigeminal neuralgia. It belongs to a class of drugs known as anticonvulsants and works by reducing the abnormal electrical activity in the brain that causes seizures and pain. Key Benefits - Effective in controlling seizures and nerve pain - Helps improve quality of life for patients with epilepsy - Available in a convenient 200mg tablet form - Can be taken with or without food - Provides long-lasting relief for chronic pain How It Works Carbatit 200mg contains the active ingredient carbamazepine, which works by stabilizing the electrical activity in the brain. This helps prevent seizures and reduces the intensity of nerve pain. It does this by blocking sodium channels in the brain, which are involved in the transmission of electrical signals. Directions for Use 1. Take Carbatit 200mg exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. 2. Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. 3. You can take this medication with or without food. 4. Do not crush, chew, or break the tablet before taking it. 5. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Precautions - Inform your doctor if you have a history of liver or kidney disease before taking Carbatit 200mg. - Avoid drinking alcohol while taking this medication, as it can increase the risk of side effects. - Do not suddenly stop taking Carbatit 200mg without consulting your doctor, as it can lead to withdrawal symptoms. - This medication may cause dizziness or drowsiness, so avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how it affects you. Storage Instructions Store Carbatit 200mg at room temperature away from moisture and heat. Keep the medication out of reach of children and pets. Do not store it in the bathroom or near the kitchen sink. name: Cellzol 2.5mg Tablets
description:
Product Overview Cellzol 2.5mg Tablets are a medication used to treat breast cancer in postmenopausal women. They belong to a class of drugs known as aromatase inhibitors, which work by decreasing the amount of estrogen produced in the body. This helps to slow or stop the growth of cancer cells that require estrogen to grow. Key Benefits - Effective treatment for breast cancer - Helps to reduce the risk of cancer recurrence - May be used as adjuvant therapy after surgery or radiation - Convenient oral tablet form - Well-tolerated by most patients How It Works Letrozole, the active ingredient in Cellzol 2.5mg Tablets, works by inhibiting the enzyme aromatase, which is responsible for converting androgens into estrogen. By reducing estrogen levels in the body, letrozole helps to deprive estrogen-dependent cancer cells of the hormone they need to grow and proliferate. Directions for Use - Take Cellzol 2.5mg Tablets exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. - The usual dose is one tablet taken orally once daily, with or without food. - Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. - Do not crush, chew, or break the tablet. - If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Precautions - Inform your doctor if you have a history of liver problems, osteoporosis, or high cholesterol. - Letrozole may cause dizziness or drowsiness. Avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how this medication affects you. - This medication may harm an unborn baby. Use effective birth control while taking Cellzol 2.5mg Tablets. - Do not breastfeed while using this medication. Storage Instructions Store Cellzol 2.5mg Tablets at room temperature away from moisture and heat. Keep the tablets in their original packaging and out of reach of children. name: Clozox Topical Cream
description:
Product Overview Clozox Topical Cream is a powerful antifungal medication containing the active ingredient Clotrimazole. It is used to treat various fungal infections of the skin, including athlete's foot, jock itch, and ringworm. Key Benefits - Effectively treats fungal infections of the skin - Soothes itching, burning, and discomfort - Fast-acting formula for quick relief - Easy-to-use cream application - Can be used for both adults and children How It Works Clotrimazole works by stopping the growth of fungi on the skin. It interferes with the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the cell membranes of fungi. By disrupting this process, Clozox Topical Cream effectively kills the fungus and helps to eliminate the infection. Directions for Use 1. Wash and dry the affected area thoroughly before applying the cream. 2. Apply a thin layer of the cream to the affected skin and surrounding area. 3. Gently massage the cream into the skin until it is absorbed. 4. Use the cream as directed by your healthcare provider or as indicated on the packaging. Precautions - Avoid getting the cream in your eyes, nose, or mouth. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. - Do not cover the treated area with bandages or dressings unless directed by a healthcare professional. - Consult a doctor before using the cream on children under the age of 2. Storage Instructions Store Clozox Topical Cream at room temperature, away from heat and moisture. Keep the cream out of reach of children and pets. Do not freeze the product. description:

Precautions - Inform your doctor about any allergies or medical conditions before taking Donecept 10mg Tablets. - Avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medication, as it may increase the risk of side effects. - Keep this medication out of reach of children and pets. - Do not stop taking Donecept without consulting your healthcare provider, as sudden discontinuation may lead to a worsening of symptoms. Product Overview Jibrone 0.5mg Tablets are a prescription medication that contains the active ingredient Alprazolam. These tablets are commonly used to treat anxiety disorders, panic disorders, and anxiety associated with depression. Key Benefits - Relieves symptoms of anxiety and panic disorders - Helps in calming the mind and reducing stress - Can improve sleep quality for individuals with anxiety-related sleep disturbances How It Works Alprazolam, the active ingredient in Jibrone 0.5mg Tablets, belongs to a class of medications called benzodiazepines. It works by enhancing the effects of a natural chemical in the body called gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA). This neurotransmitter helps to calm the brain and nervous system, leading to a reduction in anxiety and panic symptoms. Directions for Use 1. Take Jibrone 0.5mg Tablets exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. 2. Swallow the tablet whole with a full glass of water. 3. It is typically taken 2-3 times a day, with or without food. 4. Do not crush or chew the tablet, as this can affect the medication's effectiveness. Precautions - Do not exceed the prescribed dose of Jibrone 0.5mg Tablets. - Avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medication, as it can increase the risk of side effects. - Inform your healthcare provider of any other medications you are taking, as they may interact with Alprazolam. Storage Instructions Store Jibrone 0.5mg Tablets at room temperature, away from moisture and heat. Keep the medication out of reach of children and pets. Do not store in the bathroom. Manufacturer Information Jibrone 0.5mg Tablets are manufactured by Martin Dow, a reputable pharmaceutical company known for producing high-quality medications. description:
Product Overview Kartilerg 0.025% 5ml Drops by Vega are an effective ophthalmic solution designed to provide relief from allergies and inflammation in the eyes. It contains the active ingredient Ketotifen, which helps to alleviate symptoms such as itching, redness, and watering eyes. Key Benefits - Provides relief from itching, redness, and watering eyes - Helps to reduce inflammation in the eyes - Alleviates symptoms of allergies such as hay fever and pet dander - Easy-to-use dropper for precise application - Suitable for both adults and children over the age of 3 years How It Works Ketotifen, the active ingredient in Kartilerg 0.025% Drops, works by blocking the release of certain substances in the body that cause allergic reactions. It helps to prevent the symptoms of allergies from occurring, providing fast and effective relief for irritated eyes. Directions for Use 1. Wash your hands before using the eye drops. 2. Tilt your head back and gently pull down your lower eyelid to create a small pocket. 3. Hold the dropper directly over your eye and instill the prescribed number of drops. 4. Blink a few times to evenly distribute the medication. 5. Repeat in the other eye if necessary. 6. Replace the cap tightly after each use. Precautions - Do not touch the dropper tip to any surface to avoid contamination. - Do not use if the solution has changed color or become cloudy. - Contact your healthcare provider if you experience any severe side effects. Storage Instructions Store Kartilerg 0.025% Drops at room temperature away from moisture and heat. Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use. Do not freeze. Manufacturer Information Vega Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. Manufactured in compliance with GMP standards. Overall, Kartilerg 0.025% 5ml Drops by Vega are a reliable solution for managing eye allergies and inflammation. With its convenient dropper and fast-acting formula, it is a must-have for anyone seeking relief from irritated eyes.

Storage Instructions Store Ketonaz Lotion in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and heat. Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use to prevent contamination.
